{{Quote|Spiced caf. Hot. A tankard.|[[Jax Pavan]], ordering at the ''[[Oyu'baat]]''|<ref name="TLJ" />}}
'''Spiced caf''' was a blend of [[Caf/Legends|caf]] that made use of [[Spice/Legends|spices]] to enhance the drink's flavor. The ''[[Oyu'baat]]'' [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], located within the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]], served spiced caf. The beverage gained a degree of notability over [[Time/Legends|time]], even among non-[[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]], and it became a popular menu item.<ref name="TLJ" />

While staying on Mandalore, the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]-in-hiding [[Jax Pavan]] came to the ''[[Oyu'baat]]'' seeking information on the whereabouts of his captured [[Thi Xon Yimmon|friend]]. There, he ordered a mug of spiced caf while waiting to meet with [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] [[Tyno Fabris]].<ref name="TLJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Spiced caf first appeared in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the novel [[The Last Jedi (novel)|''The Last Jedi'']], co-written by [[Author/Legends|authors]] [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Maya Kaathryn Bohnhoff]], and published [[February 26]], [[2013]].
